description: Defines the NotesApi interface for remote data synchronization in the note organizer app, with suspended functions for pushing notes and fetching updated notes.

classes.name: NotesApi
classes.description: A minimal remote API interface for synchronizing notes with a backend, including methods to push and fetch notes.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously pushes a list of notes to the remote backend.

methods.name: fetchNotesUpdatedSince
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notes updated since a given timestamp.
